# Purpose

Use this log throughout the semester to collect your observations from each homework assignment. Your final individual reflection will be much easier to write if you update this file every week.

For each homework, write in complete sentences. You do not need long paragraphs, but your notes should be specific enough that you can understand them later.


# Homework 1

## Main Question

What did this homework ask you to investigate?

## Important Result

Write down one numerical result, table, or graph from this homework that seems important to you.

## Observation

What pattern did you notice?

## Interpretation

What do you think this pattern means?

## Limitation Or Caution

What should someone be careful about when interpreting this result?

## Question For Later

What question do you still have?
